name: community-rowan
summary: Community patch (a community member's list, OK'd 16 Oct; heal and Sourblossom fix from a community member's 21 Oct requests): Rowan's passive heal and its tooltips, a Sourblossom keeping his passive when an Earth Rend arc or the ult's Overgrowth ends, and Dourling Caltrops; CC immunity on Rowan's and Belroth's dashes and on the Rush boon, as in Aug 2022

assets.why: Rowan, Dourling Dive (Space): immune to stun, root, charm and fear while dashing, as in Aug 2022 (Feb still has ApplyUnstoppable but never calls it). Dourling Caltrops: the vines lie on the path Rowan just dashed, behind him (Feb put them ahead of him), and their look appears there.
Rowan, Dourling Caltrops: the vines' collision box is no longer drawn in the game (the "cube").
Rowan, Dourling Caltrops: the vines look thorny like Iron Thorns instead of replaying the Dourling Dive burst, and appear where the vines are (the cue's location) instead of on Rowan.

Rowan, passive: on Overgrowth he heals 1.8 % of his missing health every quarter second (7.2 % per second; Heal Sprite x1.65), recomputed every tick from his health at that moment. Feb heals 2 % per tick times the share of health he was missing when he stepped on, fixed for that stay (from 90 HP: 1.8 %; stepping on at full health: about nothing, even after he is hit). So from low health he heals as much as before our 17 Oct patch (2 % per second plus 3 HP per second: a community member found it too little), and he no longer loses the heal by stepping on healthy.

Rowan, Sourblossom: while he stands in its Overgrowth ring, the plant gives his passive back whenever he lacks it. An Earth Rend arc or the ult's Overgrowth (The Bloomblade) that ended, or that he walked out of, took the passive away although he still stood in the ring (they only see the plant's small body, not its ring), and the plant gave it only when he stepped in again.
Rowan, passive tooltip: the real heal, 7.2 % of his missing HP per second (MissingHealthHPS x 4: the heal ticks four times a second at that rate; Feb said 2 %, our 17 Oct patch 2 % plus 3 HP).
Rowan, Heal Sprite tooltip: the real increase, 65 % (ItemRegenMultiplier 1.65; the tooltip computed 1.65 x 50 = 82.5 %).
Belroth, Vicious Lunge (Space): immune to roots, stuns, charms, fears and knockbacks while lunging, as in Aug 2022 (Feb still has ApplyUnstoppable but never calls it).
Rush (boon): a stun or root no longer stops the dash; it lands when the dash ends, as in Aug 2022 (Feb flagged the dash as one crowd control cancels).
